feature: Aturan stage khusus PLUS: TS-RED dari PLUS boleh diterapkan sampai stage CSD/CSR/COS, di luar daftar stage TS biasa
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS17.14. checkStageAllowed melonggarkan stage hanya jika source PLUS dan reason RED (komentar menyebut fix OCMS-DF-2026-025). Teks OCMS17.14/17.15 tidak menyebut aturan ini; kemungkinan dicakup story reduksi atau court yang tidak diperiksa di chunk ini. Daftar stage asli ada di SystemConstant.ProcessingStage.PLUS_REDUCTION_COURT_ALLOWED_STAGES dan tidak dibaca ulang.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS17.14. checkStageAllowed relaxes the stage list only when the source is PLUS and the reason is RED (the comment cites the OCMS-DF-2026-025 fix). The text of OCMS17.14/17.15 does not mention this rule; it is probably covered by a reduction or court story that was not checked in this chunk. The actual stage list is in SystemConstant.ProcessingStage.PLUS_REDUCTION_COURT_ALLOWED_STAGES and was not re-read.

feature: Auto Revival me-revive baris TS yang sudah due satu per satu dan mempertahankan suspensi lain yang masih aktif di VON/eVON
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS17.12/17.15. Setelah baris TS due di-revive, sisa suspensi aktif dihitung dan VON diperbarui ke suspensi terbaru dengan tanggal revival terjauh. Teks OCMS17.12-17.15 tidak membahas revival; kemungkinan dicakup story revival yang tidak diperiksa di chunk ini. Job berjalan lewat cron toppanupload (enabled=true di cron-schedules-prod.properties:62); nilai server asli tidak bisa diverifikasi dari repo.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS17.12/17.15. After a due TS row is revived, the remaining active suspensions are computed and VON is updated to the latest suspension with the furthest revival date. The text of OCMS17.12-17.15 does not discuss revival; it is probably covered by a revival story that was not checked in this chunk. The job runs through the toppanupload cron (enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties:62); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo.
